# Enterprise Pricing Plan — 2026

## Plan Tiers

### Starter Plan
- **Price**: $49/month (billed annually) or $59/month (monthly)
- **Users**: Up to 5 team members
- **Storage**: 50GB document storage
- **API Calls**: 10,000 API calls per month
- **Models**: Access to standard models only
- **Support**: Community forum + email (48hr response)
- **Audit Log Retention**: 90 days
- **SLA**: 99.5% uptime

### Professional Plan
- **Price**: $199/month (billed annually) or $249/month (monthly)
- **Users**: Up to 25 team members
- **Storage**: 250GB document storage
- **API Calls**: 100,000 API calls per month
- **Models**: All models including latest releases
- **Support**: Priority email (8hr response) + chat
- **Audit Log Retention**: 365 days (1 year)
- **SLA**: 99.9% uptime with financial credits

### Enterprise Plan
- **Price**: Custom quote (starting at $2,000/month)
- **Users**: Unlimited team members
- **Storage**: 2TB document storage
- **API Calls**: 1,000,000+ API calls per month
- **Models**: All models + custom fine-tuned models
- **Support**: Dedicated account manager + 24/7 phone/chat
- **Audit Log Retention**: 730 days (2 years), configurable up to 7 years
- **SLA**: 99.99% uptime with financial credits
- **Additional**: SSO/SAML, on-premise deployment option, private VPC, custom data retention policies, advanced RBAC

## Regional Compliance

| Region | Data Residency | Audit Log Retention |
|--------|---------------|-------------------|
| US (us-east-1) | US only | Up to 7 years |
| EU (eu-west-1) | EU only (GDPR) | Up to 7 years |
| APAC (ap-southeast-1) | Singapore | Up to 7 years |
| China (cn-north-1) | China mainland | Up to 5 years |

APAC enterprise customers must maintain audit logs for a minimum of 730 days (2 years) per regional financial regulations. EU customers have "right to erasure" which may override retention policies.

## Volume Discounts

Annual commitment discounts:
- 1-year: 10% discount
- 2-year: 18% discount
- 3-year: 25% discount

Non-profit organizations receive an additional 15% discount on any plan. Educational institutions qualify for special academic pricing (contact sales).
